title: Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation ("Cross-site Scripting") vulnerability in Drupal Stage…
description: A Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) vulnerability exists in the Drupal Stage File Proxy module due to improper neutralization of input during web page generation. This affects versions from 0.0.0 to 3.1.7 and from 4.0.0 to 4.0.1. The vulnerability allows injection of malicious scripts into web pages generated by the module.
